fullContentHtml:
Delhi High Court JJA Main Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : High Court of Delhi has released the Main Exam Date for the Junior Judicial Assistant JJA / Restorer. This recruitment was released for 152 posts. Applications for the Delhi High Court JJA / Restorer Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 04 February 2026, to 23 February 2026. The pre examination was conducted on 22 March 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this Examination can download their Delhi High Court JJA Main Exam Date 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 04 February 2026
  • Last Date : 23 February 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 23 February 2026
  • Form Correction Last Date : 26 February to 01 March
  • Exam Date : 22 March 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Answer Key : 24 March 2026
  • Result : 25 April 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 24 May 2026 (Postponed)
  • New Mains Exam Date : 04 October 2026
  • Revised Result : 07 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 1300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
